metadata.description: One plugin for the oh-my-pi token economy: prefix-cache accounting and advice for every provider whose models report cached input tokens (DeepSeek, OpenCode, Google Gemini, LithosAI, Anthropic, OpenAI), a cache-safe tool-result reducer, and the account behind the active model. One command, one settings menu, one status row.

plugins.name: omp-token-mega
plugins.description: Merged token plugin for oh-my-pi. Accounts the prefix cache on every provider whose models report cached input tokens — DeepSeek, OpenCode, Google Gemini, LithosAI, Anthropic, OpenAI — with hit rate, miss attribution, tool-catalogue drift and subagent shards, and names the one omp setting that keeps the prefix byte-stable (provider.appendOnlyContext) wherever omp does not turn append-only context on by itself. Reduces live tool results before they are sent (terminal escapes, identical line runs, over-long lines, pretty-printed JSON), collapses byte-identical results by content hash, elides over-budget results behind artifact:// handles, audits the request envelope with copy-paste omp config advice, reports the account behind the active model — DeepSeek's polled balance, LithosAI's published rates, and the session's USD cost on either — and registers the LithosAI provider with its /login flow, 1M-token context windows, measured tokens/second and per-minute rate-limit budgets. Every metric is drawn on ONE status row. Never rewrites history, so every provider's prefix cache keeps its hits.
